name: com.loopland.game
description: LoopLand: a premium Monopoly-style board game for VRChat worlds. Networked 2-6 player game, animated particle tokens, 3D dice, persistent Loop Coins, an in-game cosmetics store and VRChat Creator Economy (Udon Products) integration. One-click scene builder: LoopLand > Build Game In Scene. Also includes a networked soda fountain (LoopLand > Build Drink Machine In Scene): cups lock into the machine, push-button UI with VR finger presses, pour / fizz / slurp sounds and cup respawning.
